name: Gallio
bio: Gallio, the Roman proconsul of Achaia, had the Jews of Corinth bring Paul before his judgment seat on the charge of persuading men to worship God contrary to the law; before Paul could even speak in his defense, Gallio dismissed the case as a dispute over Jewish law rather than a crime, and drove the accusers from the tribunal, caring nothing when the crowd then beat Sosthenes (Acts 18:12-17).
